name: Obsidian 10
description: Manufactured by Sienar Fleet Systems, Obsidian 10 was a TIE/ln starfighter serving the Imperial Navy's Obsidian Squadron, which was piloted by OS-72-10. By 4 ABY, Obsidian 10 was stationed aboard the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Thunderflare and was further recalled to defend the Imperial Death Star II battle station during its construction in the Endor system.
